question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**pandemic**" refers to a disease that is prevalent over a whole country or the world, such as Covid-19, **which has had a global impact on education and many other sectors.**
 
• "**Local**" refers to something confined to a particular area, which does not capture the global impact of the situation described.
 
• "**Endemic**" refers to a disease regularly found among particular people or in a certain area, which does not describe the wide-reaching effects mentioned.
 
• "**Epidemic**" refers to a widespread occurrence of a disease in a community at a particular time, but **"pandemic" **is the more appropriate term due to the global spread described in the passage.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The latest pandemic__ has altered the education of millions of people around the world. New approaches and improvements in the school system are urgently required.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Local (स्थानीय)**: relating to a region close to where a person lives.
 
• **Endemic (स्थानिक)**: regularly found among particular people or in a certain area.
 
• **Epidemic (महामारी)**: a widespread occurrence of an infectious disease in a community at a particular time.
